evidence.excerpt: To support the development and evaluation of such measures, we introduce SES-Bench, a speech emotion similarity benchmark built from human comparisons of two candidate utterances against a shared reference.

evidence.label: 描述评分指标或评测协议
evidence.excerpt: SES-Judge significantly outperforms embedding cosine similarity and prompted large audio-language models in preference accuracy and correlation with human ratings that capture both preference direction and strength.
